embryo_track.diagnostics.info_html:
Model Diagnostics
This tool shows how the same measurement produces different predictions across embryo counts.
Use this to validate biological correction factors.
embryo_track.diagnostics.summary_baselin: Using TWIN (2 embryo) model as baseline for all predictions
embryo_track.diagnostics.summary_no_base: ERROR: No twin (2 embryo) baseline model available!
embryo_track.diagnostics.summary_invalid:
ERROR: COL value {value} mm produced invalid result (NaN/Inf)
This value may be outside the interpolation range.
embryo_track.diagnostics.summary_bio_int:
All predictions use the TWIN (2 embryo) model as baseline.
Corrections account for biological growth rate differences:
embryo_track.diagnostics.summary_single:
• Single embryo: Gets MORE resources → grows FASTER
  → reaches same size EARLIER → SUBTRACT 6 days
embryo_track.diagnostics.summary_triplet:
• Triple embryos: Share resources → grow SLOWER
  → reach same size LATER → ADD 4 days
